item.title: Word of the Day: Castigate
item.description: Phonetic: /cas·ti·gate/ Part of Speech: Verb Definition reprimand (someone) severely.“he was castigated for not setting a good example” Similar: reprimand, rebuke, admonish The judge castigated the lawyers for their lack of preparation.

item.title: Demons use home runs to sweep UTA
item.description: A season ago, the Northwestern State baseball team blasted a school single-season record 63 home runs. That was the good news. item.title: Dogs, goats and donkeys: Krewe of Wag-uns brings the fun
item.description: It is just not Mardi Gras in Natchitoches until the Krewe of Wag-uns parade rolls! The long-standing local tradition, now sponsored by FAUNA (Friends All United for Natchitoches Animals), rolled on Feb. 15 in downtown Natchitoches, prior to the Krewe of Dionysos parade. This year’s parade featured beads, trinkets and family fun for all ages. … Continue reading Dogs, goats and donkeys: Krewe of Wag-uns brings the fun
